Architecture overview¶

hrtfpykit provides three main working layers.

SOFA layer¶

The SOFA layer loads and edits SOFA files as structured objects. It is the lowest public layer and works with dimensions, global attributes, variable attributes, variables, convention checks, and file saving.

Canonical imports:

from hrtfpykit.sofa import load_sofa
from hrtfpykit.sofa.sofa import SOFA

HRTF layer¶

The HRTF layer loads SOFA files as acoustic HRTF/HRIR objects. A loaded HRTF keeps both time-domain impulse responses and frequency-domain transfer functions available through one object.

Canonical imports:

from hrtfpykit.hrtf import load_hrtf
from hrtfpykit.hrtf.hrtf import HRTF

Dataset layer¶

The dataset layer builds indexed dataset objects from local or downloadable HRTF datasets. Specs define which resources become sample inputs and targets.

Canonical imports:

from hrtfpykit.datasets import HUTUBS, SONICOM
from hrtfpykit.datasets import HRTFSpec, MetadataSpec, MeshSpec

Plot layer¶

Plotting is documented separately from HRTF processing. Single-HRTF plots are available as methods on loaded HRTF objects. Compare plots are public functions under hrtfpykit.plots.

Canonical imports:

from hrtfpykit.hrtf import load_hrtf
from hrtfpykit.plots import compare_magnitude

Import surface¶

The root package currently exposes only package metadata. Use subpackage imports for user workflows:

import hrtfpykit

hrtfpykit.__version__

Do not rely on from hrtfpykit import load_hrtf or from hrtfpykit import load_sofa. Use hrtfpykit.hrtf and hrtfpykit.sofa instead.
